## Upgrading from 1.x

Read the [2.x migration guide](https://github.com/modern-python/lite-bootstrap/blob/main/docs/migration/to-2.x.md)
for replacement APIs, configuration examples, and actions for each affected framework.

## Breaking changes

- Raise Sentry to `>=2.70,<3`; explicit `data_collection` replaces SDK event scrubbing and `send_default_pii` opt-ins (#359, #379).
- Default Sentry session tracking to off and log breadcrumbs to `WARNING` (#360).
- Use lean request error capture on Litestar, FastAPI, and FastMCP when tracing is off; stop creating request transactions and attach only bodies read by handlers. Litestar handled 4xx exceptions are no longer reported (#361, #362).
- Leave Sentry auto-enabling integrations off while tracing is off, subject to the HTTP lean-capture policy (#363).
- Omit OpenTelemetry ASGI receive/send spans by default (#364).
- Suppress duplicate Prometheus HTTP series when OpenTelemetry HTTP metrics are configured (#365).
- Omit health requests from OpenTelemetry spans and HTTP metrics by default (#366).
- Remove deprecated imports, config fields, logging protocols, and custom instrument member aliases (#367).
- Raise OpenTelemetry API/SDK/exporters to 1.42 and instrumentation to 0.63b0 (#368).
- Default `service_debug` to `False` and preserve explicitly configured Litestar debug mode (#369).
- Return 503, rather than 500, for unhealthy health checks (#370).
- Require Litestar 2.22 or later for all Litestar extras (#371).
- Default `opentelemetry_insecure` to `None`: environment settings apply, and schemeless gRPC endpoints use TLS unless overridden (#372).
- Default service identity fields to `None`, honor `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME`, omit unset resource versions, and use an explicit `service_version` as the Sentry release (#373).
- Require FastMCP `>=4.0,<5`; access logs now include notifications and pre-handler failures (#374).
- Make FastStream Prometheus routes and middleware opt-in through a non-empty metrics path, and use the default collector registry (#375).
- Require both application and config type arguments for `BaseBootstrapper` subclasses (#376).
- Remove logging buffer settings and write structlog output immediately (#378).
- Remove `MemoryLoggerFactory` and its instrument property; propagate structlog and framework loggers to root and inherit root levels (#405).
- Roll back failed bootstrap and reject reuse of the failed instance (#406).
- Normalize and redact structured Sentry events/breadcrumbs before callbacks and omit their frame locals (#408).
- Isolate Sentry context per FastStream message (#409).
- Enforce Sentry request body capture limits in lean capture (#410).
- Tear down FastAPI and FastMCP observability after user lifespan shutdown (#412, #413).
- Preserve application root handlers and restore the previous root level during logging teardown (#415).
- Reject commas in FastAPI and FastMCP OpenTelemetry URL exclusion patterns (#417).
- Respect disabled FastAPI offline docs routes independently (#418).
- Reject invalid non-empty health and metrics paths at config construction (#419).
- Serve both FastStream health/metrics slash spellings; review alternate-path custom routes (#420).
- Default CORS methods to `["*"]` on FastAPI and Litestar when origins are configured (#423).
- Exclude health and scrape traffic from Prometheus HTTP metrics (#424).
- Omit JSON log `tracing` outside a recording span (#425).
- Remove `InstrumentSkippedWarning`; use `InstrumentDependencyMissingWarning` directly (#427).
- Silently skip the default Prometheus path when `prometheus_client` is missing; custom paths still warn (#428).
- Skip SDK tracing without a span processor; install externally owned providers before bootstrap to preserve custom tracing (#430).
